Author: kittenhaswares-ui
Name: Seiton Sense
Punchline: Persistent Seiton decisions, personal PvP warnings, and an optional Purify buffer.
Description: A local Crystalline Conflict reaction-cue HUD with an optional Wolves' Den duel test mode. Ninja gets persistent PREP and SHIFT+slot Seiton decisions; every job can see selected PvP warnings. The one-key/one-attempt Purify experiment is disabled by default.
Changelog: Added a Wolves' Den duel test mode for the complete HUD and optional Purify experiment. FFXIV's exact native duel opponent is shown as synthetic S1, including party-member duels; invalid identity fails closed. Crystalline Conflict keeps native S1-S5 mapping, while Frontline and Rival Wings remain excluded.
